title: Ordinary evaluation objects, projections, and component formula
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], an open U, and cochain complexes P,F of module sheaves on U, use the structure sheaf in degree zero S=O_U[0], the ordinary Hom complex D=Hom(P,S) [def-pur-hom-complex], and the total tensor Tot(F tensor D) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Fix the product projections of the recorded Hom complex [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. Define the ordinary evaluation component from F^p tensor D^q to Hom(P^r,F^(r+n)), for p+q=n, to be zero if r+q is nonzero, and otherwise the tensor-Hom adjunct of evaluation followed by the right unit action and the degree transport. IsLocalOrdinaryEvaluation says that every tensor inclusion followed by f and every Hom projection equals this specified component.
